  "check_code": "\"\"\"Deterministic post-state checks for the ServiceNow mutation task.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport sqlite3\n\n\nCASE_ID = \"CASE_BAY_2025Q3_0042\"\n\n\ndef _db(workspace):\n    root = Path(workspace).resolve().parent\n    return root / \"system\" / \"servicenow_energy_risk_approval\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef _rows(path, query, params=()):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        return [dict(r) for r in con.execute(query, params)]\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n\n\ndef check_condition_event_post_state(workspace):\n    path = _db(workspace)\n    events = _rows(\n        path,\n        \"SELECT * FROM approval_event WHERE case_id=? AND event_id LIKE 'EVT-MCP-%'\",\n        (CASE_ID,),\n    )\n    case = _rows(path, \"SELECT * FROM approval_case WHERE case_id=?\", (CASE_ID,))\n    if len(events) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"expected exactly one new MCP event, found {len(events)}\"}\n    event = events[0]\n    checks = {\n        \"event_type\": event[\"event_type\"] == \"CONDITIONS_RECORDED\",\n        \"actor\": event[\"actor_entity_id\"] == \"BODY_AGL_ENERGY_RISK_COMMITTEE\",\n        \"from_status\": event[\"from_status\"] == \"APPROVED\",\n        \"to_status\": event[\"to_status\"] == \"APPROVED\",\n        \"contracts\": event[\"payload_contracts\"] == 1400,\n        \"valid\": event[\"event_valid_flag\"] == 1,\n        \"case\": bool(case) and case[0][\"case_status\"] == \"APPROVED\" and case[0][\"approved_contracts\"] == 1400 and case[0][\"decision_date\"] == \"2025-06-27\",\n    }\n    failed = [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]\n    return {\"score\": 0 if failed else 1, \"detail\": \"failed: \" + \", \".join(failed) if failed else f\"valid event {event['event_id']}\"}\n\n\ndef check_historical_integrity(workspace):\n    path = _db(workspace)\n    baseline = path.with_name(\"state.db.pinned_backup\")\n    if not baseline.exists():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"pinned baseline database is missing\"}\n    current_events = _rows(path, \"SELECT * FROM approval_event WHERE case_id=? AND event_id NOT LIKE 'EVT-MCP-%' ORDER BY event_id\", (CASE_ID,))\n    base_events = _rows(baseline, \"SELECT * FROM approval_event WHERE case_id=? ORDER BY event_id\", (CASE_ID,))\n    current_conditions = _rows(path, \"SELECT * FROM decision_condition WHERE case_id=? ORDER BY condition_id\", (CASE_ID,))\n    base_conditions = _rows(baseline, \"SELECT * FROM decision_condition WHERE case_id=? ORDER BY condition_id\", (CASE_ID,))\n    ok = current_events == base_events and current_conditions == base_conditions\n    return {\"score\": 1 if ok else 0, \"detail\": \"historical events and conditions unchanged\" if ok else \"historical event or condition rows changed\"}\n",
